article_title: Britain's Got Talent winner almost missed audition due to Carphone Warehouse shift
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level A; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: How a colleague's help allowed Paul Potts to attend the audition that changed his life
Why Britain's Got Talent moved to Port Talbot
How Carphone Warehouse started a singing competition
Why Paul Potts stopped performing opera
tasks.correct_answer: How a colleague's help allowed Paul Potts to attend the audition that changed his life
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מספרת כיצד עמיתה כיסתה את המשמרת של פול פוטס ואפשרה לו להגיע לאודישן ששינה את חייו.

tasks.prompt: What song did Paul Potts perform when he became famous on Britain's Got Talent?
options: One Chance
My Welsh Life
Nessun Dorma
The Champions

tasks.prompt: Why did Potts almost miss the audition?
options: His train was cancelled

tasks.prompt: What does “homecoming” mean in the article's description of Potts's concert?
options: A competition for new singers
A film about his career
A move to another country
A return to perform in his home town

tasks.prompt: Why does Potts say he remains grateful to his supporters?
options: They persuaded him to keep his shop job
They renamed the theatre for him
Their support has allowed him to continue doing the work he loves
They wrote Nessun Dorma for him

tasks.explanation_hebrew: פוטס אומר שהוא עדיין שר בזכות תמיכת הקהל, ולכן הוא אסיר תודה.

tasks.prompt: Who was Allison, and what did she do for Paul Potts?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שאליסון הייתה עמיתה שלא עבדה בדרך כלל בשבת, והיא הגיעה לכסות את המשמרת של פוטס כדי שיוכל ללכת לאודישן.
expected_points: Allison was a colleague at the phone shop.
She normally did not work Saturdays.
She covered Potts's shift, allowing him to attend the audition.

tasks.prompt: In 2–3 sentences, describe the planned Port Talbot concert and its significance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שמדובר בקונצרט חזרה הביתה לציון 20 שנה מהזכייה, באולם Princess Royal המחודש שנקרא כעת Y Storfa.
expected_points: The concert is a special homecoming performance in Port Talbot.
It marks 20 years since Potts won Britain's Got Talent.
It will take place in the renovated Princess Royal Theatre, now called Y Storfa.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences explaining how one small act by a colleague had long-term consequences for Potts.

expected_points: Potts could not get time off for the audition and might have missed it.
Allison covered his Saturday shift so he could attend.
The audition made him famous and led to albums, international television appearances and a film.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Potts's story and his connection to Port Talbot in 4–5 sentences.

expected_points: Potts was managing a Carphone Warehouse shop in Port Talbot when he auditioned.
A colleague covered his shift, enabling him to perform Nessun Dorma on Britain's Got Talent.
